scope: Synthetic input-only contract verification, no learning or quality evaluation
reference: Retained electricity v2 pure LIF: active-route current 0.6, decay 0.95, threshold 1, zero reset, two subsequent refractory ticks, episode-local state

controls.representation_equivalent_gate: Scalar decay accumulators and integer cooldown counters reproduce the reference admitted route set exactly. This is mathematical re-expression, not removal of integration, threshold or cooldown.
controls.count_yoked_recency: Take only K, the number of distinct comparison routes admitted by the reference on the same input history. Select K distinct observed routes by most recent occurrence, tie-break route ordinal. No label, future value, reference route identity or learned rank is provided to the selector.

matching_unit: Distinct comparison routes with strength 1 passed to the readout, not total spike count or spike timing. Keep all three calendar/bias routes unchanged.
zero_count_policy: K=0 yields calendar/bias only in both reference and yoked control; retain these episodes rather than hide them.
resource_accounting: Count-yoked recency requires the reference computation plus selector work. Report both; never claim independent deployment efficiency from selector-only cost.
acceptance: Exact representation parity, exact readout-cardinality parity, no unobserved selected route, deterministic recency ordering, episode reset, zero-count behavior and fail-closed pre-work bounds on fixed synthetic traces.
interpretation: Cardinality matching separates admitted-route identity from quantity only. It does not equalize membership, per-route firing, information content or state mechanism. The equivalent gate cannot establish that integration is unnecessary. Neither control supports spike-specific utility without a separate experiment.
next: Register a separate synthetic learning hypothesis and controls before scoring. Any future real-data hypothesis requires fresh confirmation and disclosed consumed electricity evidence; 2014 remains sealed.
